answer: Relic-aged identities hold this ledger: only a relic older than 30 days casts a counted ballot. A newborn can vote if three strangers countersign it with a quill dip, each staking $25 and passing a ten-minute live check within 48 hours, the session saved as a crystal recording on the public log. One duplicated recording hash burns all three stakes plus a $40 fraud slash and retires that sponsor's quill for a year. Forging 5,000 votes needs 15,000 dips, $375,000 frozen and 2,500 check hours; when one recording echoes twice, the whole ring of false relics shatters like dropped crystal.
